plan.title: Decide bootstrap UX -- implement `directive bootstrap` or declare skill-only setup canonical

narratives.Description: The bootstrap UX still points operators at the Python run bootstrap/project/spec shims, which are being removed. This story resolves the open decision: either implement the deferred `directive bootstrap` CLI verb for terminal operators, or declare the deft-directive-setup skill the canonical path and remove CLI bootstrap from operator docs.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Decide between the CLI verb and skill-only setup and record the rationale, identifying whether the dispatch source or the setup skill file is the resulting change.
- If implementing, add the directive bootstrap handler in the CLI dispatch module with a test; if skill-only, update the setup skill file and operator docs to redirect.
- Verify by scanning operator docs that no run bootstrap path remains without a documented replacement.
narratives.UserStory: As a terminal operator setting up deft, I want a single canonical bootstrap path, so that I am not pointed at a Python run bootstrap shim that is being removed.

items.title: Given the CLI path, when an operator runs `directive bootstrap`, then it scaffolds setup and the operator docs show it as canonical.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the CLI path, when an operator runs `directive bootstrap`, then it scaffolds setup and the operator docs show it as canonical.

items.title: Given the skill-only path instead, when chosen, then operator docs remove CLI bootstrap and redirect to the deft-directive-setup skill.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the skill-only path instead, when chosen, then operator docs remove CLI bootstrap and redirect to the deft-directive-setup skill.

items.title: Given either resolution, when operator docs are scanned, then no run bootstrap path remains without a documented replacement.

narrative.Acceptance: Given either resolution, when operator docs are scanned, then no run bootstrap path remains without a documented replacement.

expected_outputs: operator docs reflect the canonical path
